scope: Legacy field interpretation; raw executed traces remain unchanged
authoritative_generation: metadata.arm, metadata.generator_mode and each retrievals[].mode identify actual generation and selection
legacy_generator: metadata.generator records the fallback callback argument of the backward-compatible search API; TypedProvider overrides that callback in Phase 5 arms
legacy_model_sha256: metadata.model_sha256 and learned_scores_used_for_scheduling describe the frozen Phase 2 comparison ranker, not the new retrieval model
retrieval_model: retrievals[].model_sha256 and models/phase5/frozen.json identify the actual Phase 5 model; learned modes use it for novelty selection and stable downstream ties
frontier_model: The Phase 4 model is also scored for annotations. Trace.algorithm, frontier_policy and actual frontier decisions identify whether it schedules states
provenance: The frozen protocol and per-run arm IDs separate generators, schedulers and external engines; no mathematical claim derives from a legacy annotation field
